rh.statement: All nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part 1/2.

prime-count.label_zh: 素数计数的平方根误差界

prime-gaps.label_zh: 相邻素数间隙的平方根级上界
prime-gaps.statement: As n tends to infinity, p_(n+1) − p_n = O(√p_n log p_n).

lindelof.statement: For every ε > 0, ζ(1/2+it) = O_ε(t^ε) as t tends to infinity.

zeta-moments.label_zh: ζ 函数所有正整数阶矩的界
zeta-moments.label_en: All positive integral moments of ζ
zeta-moments.statement: For every positive integer k and every ε > 0, (1/T) ∫_T^{2T} |ζ(1/2+it)|^k dt = O_(k,ε)(T^ε).

p-eq-np.statement: Deterministic polynomial-time decision equals nondeterministic polynomial-time decision.

p-ne-np.statement: P is a proper subclass of NP.

ph-p.label_zh: 多项式层级坍缩到 P
ph-p.statement: The polynomial hierarchy PH equals P.

np-conp.statement: The class NP is closed under complement.

p-ne-pspace.statement: P is a proper subclass of PSPACE.

factoring-p.label_zh: 整数分解有经典确定性多项式时间算法
factoring-p.statement: A deterministic Turing machine can factor every positive integer given in binary in polynomial time.

gi-p.label_zh: 图同构可在确定性多项式时间判定
gi-p.statement: Graph isomorphism for arbitrary finite undirected simple graphs is in deterministic P.

artin-reciprocity.label_zh: Langlands 互反律（Artin 表示情形）
artin-reciprocity.statement: For every number field F and every nontrivial irreducible finite-image complex representation of its absolute Galois group of dimension n, a cuspidal automorphic representation of GL(n,A_F) matches the completed L-function at all places.

artin-holomorphy.statement: Over every number field, the Artin L-function of every nontrivial irreducible complex Artin representation extends to an entire function.

bsd-rank.statement: For every elliptic curve E over Q, rank E(Q) equals the order of vanishing of L(E,s) at s=1.

tunnell-converse.statement: For square-free odd positive n, if the number of integer solutions to 2x²+y²+8z²=n equals twice the number for 2x²+y²+32z²=n, then n is the area of a rational right triangle.

hodge.statement: Every rational Hodge class on a smooth projective complex variety is the class of an algebraic cycle with rational coefficients.

lefschetz-c.label_zh: 复数域上的 Lefschetz 标准猜想 B
lefschetz-c.label_en: Lefschetz standard conjecture B over C
lefschetz-c.statement: For each smooth projective variety over C, inverses to the hard Lefschetz isomorphisms on rational Betti cohomology are induced by algebraic correspondences.

absolute-hodge.label_zh: Hodge 类皆为绝对 Hodge 类
absolute-hodge.label_en: All Hodge classes are absolute Hodge
absolute-hodge.statement: Every rational Hodge class on every smooth projective complex variety is absolute Hodge.

lefschetz-finite.label_zh: Lefschetz 标准猜想 B（有限域代数闭包）
lefschetz-finite.label_en: Lefschetz standard conjecture B over finite-field closures
lefschetz-finite.statement: For every prime p, the Lefschetz standard conjecture holds for all smooth projective varieties over the algebraic closure of F_p for the classical Weil cohomology theories, as in the hypotheses of Milne Theorems 1–2.

tate-abelian.label_zh: 有限域上阿贝尔簇的完全 Tate 猜想
tate-abelian.label_en: Full Tate conjecture for abelian varieties over finite fields
tate-abelian.statement: The full Tate conjecture in the sense of Milne §3 holds in all codimensions for abelian varieties over algebraic closures of finite fields.

hodge-standard-abelian.label_zh: 正特征阿贝尔簇的 Hodge 型标准猜想
hodge-standard-abelian.label_en: Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties in positive characteristic
hodge-standard-abelian.statement: The standard conjecture of Hodge type holds for abelian varieties in every positive characteristic for the classical Weil cohomology theories as in Milne Theorem 3.3.

almost-algebraic-hodge.label_zh: 阿贝尔簇的 Hodge 类近似代数
almost-algebraic-hodge.label_en: Almost-algebraicity of Hodge classes on abelian varieties
almost-algebraic-hodge.statement: All absolute Hodge classes on abelian varieties over fields of characteristic zero are almost-algebraic in the sense of Milne Definition 1.3.

goldbach.statement: Every even integer greater than 2 is the sum of two primes.

ternary-goldbach.statement: Every odd integer greater than 5 is the sum of three primes.
